answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A nectar streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 6708 identities takes 99048 tokens, 40 operator hours and 59 days of exposure.
